name: catalyst_open_world_temporal_external_v1
purpose: Evaluate real open-world future-association recovery rather than only leakage-free candidate generation.

historical_knowledge.association_boundary: clean2023 / Rhea release128-aligned historical mapping already audited in RHEA128_CLEAN2023_SOURCE_ALIGNMENT_V2.json
historical_knowledge.candidate_universe: data/catalyst_candidate_universes/general_merged, frozen 185918 proteins and registered reaction representations

target.artifact: official rhea2uniprot_sprot.tsv from the complete archived Rhea 2026_02 release

cells.future_pair: mapped 2026_02 pair absent from release128-aligned historical pair set and clean2023; known historical positives for the query are masked from discovery output
cells.protein_cold: future_pair plus target protein absent from clean2023 training proteins
cells.strict_double_cold: protein_cold plus query reaction absent from clean2023 training reactions; every retained positive for the query must satisfy protein-cold

label_completion: For each retained query, positives are all mapped 2026_02 Swiss-Prot positives inside the frozen candidate universe that satisfy the cell rules; do not label only the trigger pair.

authoritative_baseline.name: historical sequence_x_reaction nearest-neighbor transfer
authoritative_baseline.sequence_similarity: MMseqs2 sequence identity from candidate protein to clean2023 training proteins
authoritative_baseline.reaction_similarity: binary 2048-d DRFP Tanimoto between query and clean2023 training reactions
authoritative_baseline.score: max over historical training associations of sequence_identity(candidate, train_protein) * reaction_tanimoto(query, train_reaction)
authoritative_baseline.label_usage: historical associations only; target 2026_02 labels forbidden
authoritative_baseline.why: A strong classical homology-plus-reaction-similarity transfer baseline that can score previously unannotated candidate sequences, unlike exact-reaction lookup.

secondary_baselines: official native CLIPZyme only on a pre-performance common-support subset if >=50 retained strict-double-cold queries remain
catalyst_model: the already frozen current production R2E v4 route; no model, router, threshold, feature or candidate-support tuning is allowed from this target
post_reveal_policy: All results are final external evidence. Failed or weak cells remain failed/weak; do not change release, cell definitions, baseline weighting, similarity thresholds or candidate support after target labels are read.
